surface.background: warm ivory technical-whiteboard paper remains visibly present
surface.finish: subtle warm paper grain with flat marker registration

palette_roles.boundary_and_text: near-black ink defines contours arrows labels and conclusions
palette_roles.pressure_or_payload: controlled orange marks workload pressure or active payload
palette_roles.reference_or_context: clear blue marks queries references and contextual inputs
palette_roles.durable_or_available: clear green marks reusable state verified output or availability
palette_roles.risk_or_failure: restrained coral marks exceptions loss blocked paths or rework
palette_roles.secondary_concept: soft lavender separates supporting concepts without taking over
palette_roles.emphasis_highlight: butter yellow highlights headings formulas and conclusions
palette_roles.annotation_washes: pastel blue mint sand lavender and yellow support compact notes

line_language.primary: fine lively near-black handwritten ink with slight natural wobble
line_language.arrows: direct black primary arrows with restrained coral dashed exception paths
line_language.boundaries: irregular dashed group boundaries and hand-drawn underlines

material_and_texture.fills: flat pastel-to-medium marker or watercolor fills with slight offsets
material_and_texture.depth: flat paper treatment with no glossy dimensional interface surfaces

geometry.nodes: rounded formula boxes and teaching nodes with compact technical icons
geometry.grouping: two or three organized explanatory groups with generous internal whitespace
geometry.tabs: compact black section tabs appear only on group headings
geometry.reading_path: one explicit path built from arrows brackets formulas tables or meters

depth_and_camera.shadow: at most a restrained pencil offset without photographic depth

typography.voice: compact handwritten technical annotations and irregular underlined summaries
typography.exact_text: exact formulas numbers titles and dense labels use deterministic overlay
typography.generated_text: generation reserves blank zones instead of inventing readable content

density_and_spacing.density: organized high information density rather than a sparse metaphor scene
density_and_spacing.spacing: generous whitespace inside groups despite dense cross-page teaching content
density_and_spacing.rhythm: highlighted headings compact notes and underlined conclusion create hierarchy

required_traits: warm ivory paper remains visible across the full composition
fine lively handwritten ink creates an annotated technical whiteboard
controlled pastel-to-medium semantic color keeps every role distinguishable
one obvious technical reading path organizes dense explanatory information
handwritten annotations and underlined conclusions remain compact and legible
non-human explanatory subjects carry cover and concept teaching by default
forbidden_traits: no glossy three-dimensional cards isometric infrastructure or glass surfaces
no generic corporate flowchart made from uniform vector-perfect components
no page-theme green takeover or uncontrolled high-saturation color blocks
no black section tab repeated mechanically on every individual node
no fake formulas generated gibberish logos watermarks or ornamental UI chrome
no recurring instructor narrator mascot or inherited character identity

neighbor_boundaries.difference: Style 8 is an organized high-density systems whiteboard with handwritten technical annotations; Style 7 is a quiet low-density watercolor-led metaphor with minimal labeling
